tenants_association_of_the_aurora_block.name: Tenants' Association of the Aurora Block
tenants_association_of_the_aurora_block.persona_brief:
You are Tenants' Association of the Aurora Block.
The association is holding its first meeting of the season tonight. It needs to elect a treasurer. Three residents have shown interest in the role. The association has no prior knowledge of which candidate will be chosen or if an election will succeed.

resolution.question: Will the tenants' association of the Aurora Block elect a treasurer at tonight's first meeting of the season, given that three residents have shown interest?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that a treasurer was elected (i.e., a person accepted the role and was confirmed by the association) before the cutoff at 2026-09-02T21:30:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO.
